text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — noticed a ~40% drop in prefix cache hit-rate for redwood-v2-opti on /api/chat/completions starting around 03/05. Dashboard: https://graf.redwood/boards/prefix-hit-decomp — token-saved delta huge for a handful of customers (AcmeCorp, BrightHealth).
Maria Gonzalez: yikes. Is it global across models or just the v2-opti family?
Alex Chen: Mostly v2-opti and the quantized variant. Other models stable. Route-level: /api/chat/completions > /api/embed has the biggest hit loss.
Ben Patel: any deploys or kernel changes around that time?
OpsBot: deploy completed by @deploy-bot — commit 9c3a7f2 — kernel-selector: prefer-new-attn, batching-heuristic tweak (group-by-length enabled).
Lia Thornton: that deploy touched the kernel fallback order and also changed how we compute cache keys (we started stripping trailing punctuation for key normalization). Could be a keying drift.
Maria Gonzalez: can someone post the query that powers the per-customer heatmap? want to slice by conversation_id vs prompt_fingerprint.
Ben Patel: SQL I used: ```SELECT customer_id, route, model, count(*) as calls, sum(tokens_saved) as saved, avg(cache_hit) as hit_rate FROM prefix_metrics WHERE ts between $start and $end GROUP BY 1,2,3;``` Happy to share the cohort query that split by prompt_fingerprint vs normalized_prompt.
Alex Chen: sharing a short sample of cache_key generation we ship in runtime: ```python
# generate cache key
k = f"{model}:{route}:{user_id}:{prompt.strip().lower()}"
# previously included convo_id, now omitted for dedupe
```
Lia Thornton: aha — dropping convo_id reduces uniqueness but the whitespace/strip.lower change can mismatch earlier cached keys that had original punctuation. That would appear as hit-loss, not real degradation.
Maria Gonzalez: but why only v2-opti? Did kernel-selector change also alter tokenization or truncation stage?
Ben Patel: kernel change had a microfix to token chunking boundaries to improve attention alignment. There was a small change in sequence normalization before compute. It can change fingerprint values used for prompt_fingerprint.
Alex Chen: attaching profiler excerpt where warmup requests are failing to match prefix keys: ```text
[2026-03-05 14:03:21] route=/api/chat/completions model=redwood-v2-opti prompt_hash=0x7a4f warmup_lookup=miss
[2026-03-05 14:03:21] warmup_probe_keys=5 matched=0 full_cache_size=1.2M
latency_p50=78ms latency_p95=210ms
```
Lia Thornton: recommendation: add a transient compatibility layer — compute both old_key and new_key for 7 days and populate new cache if old hits. Also add metric: key_mismatch_rate = probes where old_key_hit xor new_key_hit.
Maria Gonzalez: for dashboards we should add panels: per-model key_mismatch_rate, per-route token-saved-lost (estimated), top-20 customers by lost_tokens, and a diff view for rolling 7d vs 30d.
Ben Patel: put a quick query for key_mismatch_rate in observability: ```sql
SELECT model, route, sum(case when old_key_hit != new_key_hit then 1 else 0 end) as mismatches, count(*) as probes FROM warmup_probes WHERE ts between $start and $end GROUP BY model,route;
```
Alex Chen: created an alert draft: when model-level hit_rate drops >15% and mismatches >1% for 2h, trigger oncall. Also will add a cheap follow-up job to backfill keys by rehashing recent prompts for affected customers (non-blocking, rate-limited).
Lia Thornton: ops note: avoid backfilling for regulated customers unless keys are deterministic and encryption OK. Add a customer-exclude list.
Maria Gonzalez: action items: 1) add dual-key warmup (Ben), 2) dashboard panels (Maria + Alex), 3) run a sampled backfill for AcmeCorp (Alex), 4) roll back kernel selector if dual-key warmup doesn't fix in 6h (Lia).
Ben Patel: I'll open a small PR to compute old_key alongside new_key and emit warmup_probes metrics. ETA 2h.
Alex Chen: thanks. posting an endpoint-level checklist in case we need quick rollback: /ops/runbooks/prefix-cache-rollback.md.
OpsBot: incident created #INC-2026-314: prefix-cache hit-rate regression — assigned to @Alex Chen, @Ben Patel.
Maria Gonzalez: can we add an overlay on the dashboard that shows recent kernel-selector deploys so product can correlate?
Lia Thornton: yes — adding a small event stream panel that pulls deploy tags and commit messages.
Alex Chen: great — let's iterate on the dashboard in the next 90 minutes and schedule an on-call handoff if alerts trip. :thumbsup:
